title: Add GitMuse to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [GitMuse](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/gitmuse) to build
- AI-powered git workflow assistant: generates Conventional Commits messages from any diff, explains error messages / stack traces with specific fixes, and writes pull request descriptions. It uses the 

Fixes #14971

gist.headline: Commit messages found their muse
gist.blurb: GitMuse joined the garden: an AI git sidekick for turning diffs into Conventional Commits, deciphering stack traces, and drafting PR descriptions. Less staring at `git diff`; more shipping the thing.
gist.summary: Added GitMuse to the app build, giving developers an AI-powered git workflow assistant that generates Conventional Commit messages from diffs, explains errors and stack traces with fixes, and writes pull request descriptions.
gist.impact: Developers can use GitMuse to turn the messy parts around commits, debugging, and PR write-ups into concrete next steps without leaving their workflow to consult the ancient scrolls.
gist.visual_concept: GitMuse is a developer-facing git workflow assistant, represented as a cozy retro terminal growing commit-message flowers from a tangled code diff. Polli should be an attentive collaborator wearing a tiny conductor hat, guiding glowing git branches into neat Conventional Commit labels while a friendly CRT robot holds a PR document; vines and flowers make the workflow feel cultivated rather than bureaucratic.
